integrity: The argument is self-contained apart from the classical squarefree almost-prime asymptotic. Finite checks support but do not prove infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Only the parity of the number of distinct prime divisors, exactly three ordered nonunit factors, and the complete zero-set/exact fiber formula are covered. The exceptional-count asymptotic invokes the standard fixed-order Landau theorem. No arbitrary-coloring bound is asserted. Unindexed equivalent results cannot be excluded.
title: Threefold monochromatic product fibers for prime-support parity
